text:
Ana: Quick async — finalizing v2 cutover timeline. Need to confirm owners for SDK header changes, proxy shim, and docs. We want a soft-deprec of v1 on 2026-05-15; hard-deprec TBD. Who owns what?

Mike: I can own the proxy shim (eng-runtime). Couple caveats: need infra toggle and a small perf benchmark before canary.

Kevin: infra toggle is almost ready, but we need the new CIDR ranges for dedicated customers. If product wants the 05/15 soft-deprec, we need the CIDR update by 05/01.

Jen: DevEx will take SDK headers + migration guide. I’ll open a tracking PR by end of day and add migration snippets. Can someone add acceptance tests for header fallback?

Tim: SRE: we’ll own canary windows + rollback playbook. Proposed canary: 72h on 10% traffic, metric gates on p50/p99 latency and error-rate <0.5%. If gating fails, auto-fallback to v1.

Ana: Sounds good. @Mike @Jen @Kevin @Tim — reply with ✅ if you accept those responsibilities and any blockers. Also call out any dependent PRs you need reviewed.

Mike: ✅ I accept. Blocker: I need a review from eng-infra on the kernel tuning change (PR #4821). Linking: https://git.reed/infra/pr/4821

Kevin: ✅ I accept. Blocker: CIDR approval from security (ticket SEC-912). I’ll follow up with @security. Also need a rollout window from SRE for infra changes.

Jen: ✅ Taking SDK headers + docs. I’ll open PR today: https://git.reed/devex/pr/2107. Tests: adding header fallback unit + e2e shim test. Can we get eng-runtime to review the e2e?

Tim: ✅ SRE on canary. Suggested window: 05/03–05/06 for dry run, then 05/07–05/10 for canary ramp. Will post playbook tomorrow. Need DevEx to provide migration test traffic patterns.

Devex Bot: Reminder — add migration examples for both sync and streaming clients. See template: ```client.migration('v2', {headers: true})```

Ana: OK — owners confirmed. Action items: Mike -> PR #4821 review; Kevin -> SEC-912 follow-up + CIDR by 05/01; Jen -> PR 2107 + migration guide + test vectors; Tim -> publish canary playbook + schedule; Ana -> announce soft-deprec to customers 05/08 if all green.

Mike: One more note — proxy shim will add a new header X-Rdwd-Proto. DevEx, include that in the guide and SDK changelog.

Jen: Will do. Also adding a code sample for header mapping.

Ana: Thanks all. If no major blockers by EOD tomorrow I’ll lock the 05/15 soft-deprec and start customer comms planning. :thumbsup: 

deploy-bot: Canary slot booked: 2026-05-07T00:00Z -> 2026-05-10T00:00Z (slot id: canary-561).
